text: As I enter this glass-walled, modern space, I feel a sense of anticipation. The sleek design and vibrant colors evoke curiosity. When I approach the display wall inside, I am struck by the celebration of innovation and discovery. 'R+D'—Research and Development—reminds me that human progress thrives on imagination and analysis. In this atmosphere, I feel inspired, eager to understand and participate in the pursuit of new ideas.
